tagline: We automate and transform. We create ways to win.
hero_kpi_rationale: Double-digit growth in annual recurring revenue is a cornerstone of Rockwell Automation's profitable growth strategy, indicating stable and predictable demand for its solutions and services.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from recurring contracts such as services, software subscriptions, and maintenance.
kpis.description: Rockwell Automation targets double-digit annual recurring revenue growth, emphasizing revenue stability and predictability through services and subscriptions as part of its long-term profitable growth framework.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in annual recurring revenue.

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, representing profit after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the company's production efficiency and pricing strategy in the industrial automation sector.
kpis.signal: Solid gross margin in industrial automation sector.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending is critical to maintaining competitive advantage in the technology sector and industrial automation solutions. MD&A mentions 'investments in technology and globalization' and 'Differentiation through Technology Innovation and Domain Expertise' as strategic priorities, but no specific R&D percentage is provided.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Capital spending for the acquisition or upgrading of physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex is an indicator of capacity expansion and investments in future infrastructure to support profitable and operational growth.
kpis.signal: Targeted investment to support future growth.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees as of the fiscal year-end date.
kpis.description: Headcount as of September 30, 2025, was 26,000 employees, distributed across North America (9,000), Europe/Middle East/Africa (5,000), Asia-Pacific (7,000), and Latin America (5,000), with 33% female representation and a culture of integrity and innovation.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth supporting revenue expansion.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €11.22 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.65 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.47 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of $1.38 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.591 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 68.0% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last seven reported fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $8.342 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.869 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: AI-Enabled Deals Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customer deals that include artificial intelligence solutions.
kpis.description: MD&A confirms that industrial AI applications are a key area of inorganic investment and that AI is part of converging megatrends (digitization and AI). However, no specific percentage or metric on AI-inclusive deals is provided in the 10-K.
kpis.signal: Growing adoption of AI-enabled solutions by customers.

kpis.name: Software Control Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the software and industrial control segment.
kpis.description: The Software Control segment includes control and visualization software, digital twins, simulation and information software, as well as network infrastructure and security. Segment composition is confirmed in the 10-K Item 1 Business section, and Logix is described as a key differentiator due to its unique integrated architecture supporting discrete, process, batch, safety, security, motion, robotics, and power control automation.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in software segment driving digital transformation.

ai_positioning.summary: Rockwell Automation positions itself as an integrator of industrial AI solutions, with AI applications as a key priority for inorganic investment, aligned with the converging megatrends of digitization and AI mentioned in the 10-K MD&A long-term strategy.
